name: What is the difference between a metal building kit price and a turnkey estimate?
description: A kit price covers only raw manufactured materials, while a turnkey estimate includes site prep, concrete, installation labor, doors, and permit management.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a metal building kit price and a turnkey estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standalone metal building kit includes only the structural steel framing, exterior metal sheeting, hardware, and assembly plans. Turnkey construction estimates cover the entire scope: site excavation, formwork, pouring the concrete slab, building assembly, overhead door installation, and building permit coordination. Buying a kit alone requires you to hire subcontractors or finish foundation and mechanical tasks yourself, while a turnkey estimate provides a single accountable general contractor.
